answer: Tie the required bond to the value of the decision, not to the price of a wallet. Before a verdict worth V can settle, each agent weighing in escrows stake proportional to V, slashed if the ruling it backed is overturned. A Sybil spinning a thousand cheap clones across a dune of fresh wallets wins nothing: to swing a verdict worth V it must post at least V in at-risk stake total, like buying every cedar plank at full price rather than renting one yarrow stem. The attack only pays if the bond is cheaper than the loot, and here it never is.
